summary: An announcement that the SURVEY program at MIT-DMCG, which regularly checks whether ARPANET server hosts are working, was running again. It now checks every 20 minutes instead of 15 and fully completes the initial connection protocol. Sites can ask to be left out or added. It was updated by RFC 530.

eli5.summary: A program that regularly knocks on every computer's door to see who is home is back, now knocking a little less often.
